name: Gupta Empire, c. 400 CE
source: Hand-drawn approximation after Schwartzberg, A Historical Atlas of South Asia (1992), plate III.D.1 (p. 25), 'South Asia in the Gupta-Vakataka Age' (DSAL map group 'The Gupta-Vakataka Age, c. A.D. 300-500'). Shows the zone of direct Gupta rule under Chandragupta II, c. 400-415, including Malwa and Gujarat after the defeat of the western Kshatrapas (Saurashtra may have been taken a few years after 400). Excludes the Vakataka allies, Kamarupa, Nepal, Samatata and the tributary republics of Rajasthan and the Punjab. Good first issue: trace properly from the DSAL scan.
